title: How to use the descale mode on a nespresso machine

pieces.say: Your Nespresso has a secret button combo.
pieces.text: Your Nespresso has a secret button combo.
pieces.label: HIDDEN SETTING

pieces.say: Here's the hidden setting. Descale mode.
Eject the capsule and empty the drip tray.
Fill the tank with descaler and half a litre of water.
On most models, hold both buttons for three seconds, until they blink fast.
Run it through, then rinse with water.
Use a proper descaler only, and don't add vinegar on top.
pieces.text: Descaler only. No vinegar on top.

pieces.say: Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.
